title: The Zero Tech Debt Mandate
facebook_comment_text: 💡 Many think "fast & cheap" saves money upfront. But the true cost often hides in *maintenance*, *debugging*, and *future development slowdowns*. Each line of un-tested, undocumented code is a ticking time bomb for your budget. What's the biggest tech debt nightmare your team has faced due to a focus on immediate velocity over long-term stability?
